title: Katie W NDE 7795
content: I left my body as my husband pulled under the awning of the emergency room. I saw them take me out of the vehicle and put me into a wheelbarrow chair looking thing. I saw the way each of the workers looked and what they were wearing. I saw my husband off to the side as I began to float farther and farther up. Then, I just saw their legs under the awning, the top of the hospital, and the mall to the side. It looked like I was floating into a huge light that looked like the full moon. It was cold outside but I was perfectly warm. I was still wearing my clothes as I floated out because as I looked down and saw my legs, they were clad with the same clothes I had been wearing. Then all of the sudden, I was rapidly sucked into what I thought was this full moon. That night the moon was a sliver, so this was 'the light' that NDErs talk about. When I got there, I saw a line of people waiting in a white room that didn't seem to have borders or lines. The light of the room was an unnatural but beautiful and comforting light. Just when I thought to myself, 'Wow there are lines even in heaven,' I was immediately sitting with my knees to my chest. I was with Jesus who was also sitting the same way. He was tall with beautiful, tan skin. His eyes were the most vibrant green-blue that I had never seen. His eyes looked like jewels. They were so full of love and I felt full of love and comfort, acceptance and utter joy. I saw myself in a glorified type of body. My hair was thick and long; my blue eyes were even more blue and my skin was flawless. Jesus took my hand and said, 'Look.' At that moment, I was shown incidents in my life where I was very mean to people or hurt people without realizing it due to self absorption or distraction. The review was so fast, in a rush, like I could see all of the incidents at once with such efficiency. I was like there was a line and then there wasn't. The way things flow there is so perfect. When He showed me all of these things, he did not condemn me but just showed me all of the lost moments of love and how it had a domino affect on others. He was so loving in all of this conviction. I looked at Him and told Him, 'I don't want to leave. I want to stay with you.' He told me, 'I know this. If you stayed, this is what would happen to your children and husband.' I saw flashes of the consequences of my early departure from their life. In the very moment that I said that I could not do that to them, I was instantly back in my body with such a jolt. When Jesus spoke with me, we never used words or voice; it was all a telepathic type of conversation. I came back to my body and heard a priest praying for me. I did come back out of my body again at some point but did not go back into the light or heaven. I saw the priest praying for me and I saw what was happening when I was out of my body, but I could not hear when I was out. I could hear when I was back in but then I could not see. It was very bizarre. I heard the medical personnel say things like, 'Could this get any worse?' and I heard a nurse say, 'God help her!' I heard them announce that I was a 'bleeder' because apparently when they were intubating me, I had a traumatic intubation. They were apparently recovering and cleaning me after the intubation. Then I went to sleep in critical condition and didn't wake up for three days.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Viewed under the emergency room awning, then saw only workers' legs, the top of the hospital, and a mall to the side while floating upward.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported it was cold outside but she was 'perfectly warm' while floating; later returned 'with such a jolt.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Rapidly 'sucked into' a huge light that looked like the full moon.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus: tall, tan skin, vibrant green-blue jewel-like eyes; loving presence.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'white room' that 'didn't seem to have borders or lines' with an 'unnatural but beautiful and comforting light'; saw a line of people waiting.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Became critically ill on arrival to the emergency room; later described traumatic intubation and being in critical condition.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Saw a 'line of people waiting' in a borderless white room; later a second OBE where she saw a priest praying but 'did not go back into the light or heaven.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE at ER arrival → drawn into light → arrival in white room with line of people → seated with Jesus → rapid life review → shown consequences for family → instant return; later a separate OBE without returning to the light.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Out-of-body state occurred again after returning, but without re-entering the light/heaven.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported alternating perception: out of body she could see but not hear; back in body she could hear but not see.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Immediate relocation into a seated position with knees to chest upon thinking about 'lines even in heaven'; perception switching between seeing (out of body) and hearing (in body).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Wow there are lines even in heaven," "I don't want to leave. I want to stay with you.", "I know this. If you stayed, this is what would happen to your children and husband."
